meta.title: 美国成熟生猪行业中的企业成长：集中化、效率、出口与资本约束
meta.scope: US observed history through 2025, sources published by cutoff; no current price or valuation quote
meta.purpose: Evidence constraints for a finite Muyuan share-growth period and incremental capital returns; not US-derived China share ceiling

conclusions: 成熟国内人均需求不排除份额成长；行业规模、公司份额、单头重量/售价须拆开。
美国大场存栏份额长期提升，但这一统计不是集团所有权 CR4；单场或农场组规模不能当牧原最终份额。
美国行业产量受出口、人口和重量共同支持；国内人均用量成熟不等于行业总需求严格零增长。
效率改进有实证，但单要素劳动生产率、窝均健仔数、PSY、MSY并非同一个指标，增速也非永久。
低成本有利于留存份额，却不保证新增资本收益超过资金成本；主动退出低回报产能是资本理性的一部分。
成长应以有限期限、份额终点、爬坡/利用率、维持与新增资本、增量ROIC/ROE联合约束。

economic_returns.limitations: Historical aggregate cost coverage frequency, not company ROE or independently sampled probability; non-ARMS survey years updated using prices and fixed latest survey production parameters.

smithfield.capacity_note: Item 2 properties table p.54 lists capacity; not actual 11.1m output. 2024 report also previously forecast 11.5m for2025; do not confuse statuses.
smithfield.contract_capital_definition: Grower provides facility initial investment, labor/frontline management; Smithfield supplies animals/feed. Contract farming is not zero capital across the chain.
smithfield.transaction_note: Company sold sows and related inventory, retained minority investments/feed supply/purchase arrangements. Does not prove equivalent national physical supply exit. Sale prices are not the cash minority contributions.
smithfield.strategy: Reduce size of internal hog production; procure more from independent suppliers with market-based agreements; continue exploring reductions medium term.
smithfield.group_multiple_limitation: Company mixes branded prepared meat, fresh pork/packing and hog production. Group multiple cannot price a pure hog production stream.
smithfield.limitations: US internal production includes company-owned animals on contract farms; Mexico separately reported. Company fiscal year and national slaughter calendar/including imported live pigs differ; no ownership CR4 inferred.

derived.limitations: Changing farm-size group, not same-firm panel or a company organic growth rate.
Gross exports/production. CWE denominator aligns broadly; not net exports or causal marginal contribution.

model_constraints.growth_term_status: scenario grid, not empirically estimated lifetime or probabilities
model_constraints.terminal_share_status: Must be separately justified by China competitive/land/feed/disease/finance evidence; US 75% farm size cohort and 64% packing CR4 are not allowable company caps.
model_constraints.biology: Use finite MSY/PSY convergence or annual improvement fade. Do not extend 2% or any positive biological productivity indefinitely; calculate constraint by breeding productivity, survival, finishing space, turns, weight and demand.
model_constraints.fcff: Growth value only if incremental after-tax ROIC exceeds WACC. Reinvestment rate g/ROIC is a steady-state accounting approximation requiring matching nominal growth and profitability.
model_constraints.fcfe: Growth value only if incremental equity return exceeds cost of equity at a consistent leverage policy. Equity reinvestment rate g/incremental ROE is a simplifying steady-state relation; full forecast uses actual capex, working capital, borrowings and debt service.
no_double_count: If head count grows solely because already-built capacity utilization improves, do not charge a complete new farm build again; still charge marginal inventory/working capital/maintenance.
If new farms are needed, reinvestment cannot remain zero while volume compounds.
Ownership transferred to contractors does not remove facilities/feed/hog inventory capital from the whole system; reflect grower fees, commitments and financing.
Do not compound both company output via MSY and again via a separate growth percentage if same productivity mechanism.
Do not assume nationwide effective capacity declines while simultaneously increasing every producer MSY and maintaining all volumes; reconcile supply balance.
A company expanding enough to replace scarce supply may partly lower industry prices; independent price and volume bull cases require a jointly coherent scenario.
